units.zh: 志第十八 五行六
units.en: Treatise 18: The Five Phases, Part Six.
units.literal: Treatise Eighteen: The Five Phases, Part Six.

units.zh: 日蚀 日抱 日赤无光 日黄珥 日中黑 虹贯日 月蚀非其月
units.en: Solar eclipse; the haloed sun; the sun dimmed to a dull red; yellow prominences on the solar disk; a dark spot on the face of the sun; a rainbow across the sun; a lunar eclipse out of season.
units.literal: Solar eclipses; the sun embraced; the sun red yet without light; the sun with yellow ear-rings; black within the sun; a rainbow piercing the sun; lunar eclipse not in its proper month.

units.zh: 光武帝建武二年正月甲子朔，日有蚀之，在危八度。
units.en: On the new moon, jiazi, in the first month of Jianwu 2 (26 CE), a solar eclipse occurred at eight degrees within the lodge Wei.
units.literal: On the jiazi new-moon day of the first month in the second year of Jianwu of Emperor Guangwu, there was a solar eclipse, at eight degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 《日蚀说》曰：「日者，太阳之精，人君之象。
units.en: The Treatise on Solar Eclipses reads: "The sun embodies supreme yang; it is the emblem of the sovereign.
units.literal: The Treatise on Solar Eclipses says: "The sun is the essence of great yang, the image of the human ruler.

units.zh: 君道有亏，有阴所乘，故蚀。
units.en: When the ruler's conduct falls short, yin force overtakes the sun, and an eclipse follows.
units.literal: The ruler's way having defect, yin rides upon it; therefore it eclipses.

units.zh: 蚀者，阳不克也。」
units.en: An eclipse means yang has lost its ascendancy."
units.literal: Eclipse means yang does not overcome."

units.zh: 其候杂说，《汉书·五行志》著之必矣。
units.en: The assorted prognostic glosses are set out at length in the Han shu Treatise on the Five Phases.
units.literal: As for the various predictive glosses, the Treatise on the Five Phases in the Han shu records them in full.

units.zh: 儒说诸侯专权，则其应多在日所宿之国。
units.en: Scholars hold that when regional lords seize unchecked power, the omen usually falls on the state whose celestial lodge the sun occupies.
units.literal: Confucian explanation: when feudal lords monopolize power, then its responses are mostly in the state where the sun lodges.

units.zh: 诸象附从，则多为王者事。
units.en: When secondary portents cluster with the eclipse, they tend to concern the throne itself.
units.literal: When various images attach and follow, then mostly they are matters of the king.

units.zh: 人君改修其德，则咎害除。
units.en: If the ruler mends his ways and cultivates virtue, the ill omen and its harm may be dispelled.
units.literal: If the human ruler reforms and cultivates his virtue, then blame and harm are removed.

units.zh: 是时，世祖初兴，天下贼乱未除。
units.en: Guangwu had only just restored the dynasty; rebels still roamed the empire.
units.literal: At this time the Shizu had first risen, and bandit turmoil under Heaven was not yet removed.

units.zh: 虚、危，齐也。
units.en: The lodges Xu and Wei correspond to the old territory of Qi.
units.literal: Xu and Wei are Qi.

units.zh: 贼张步拥兵据齐，上遣伏隆谕步，许降。
units.en: The warlord Zhang Bu held Qi with an army; the emperor sent Fu Long to negotiate and accepted his offer to submit.
units.literal: The bandit Zhang Bu held troops and occupied Qi; the sovereign sent Fu Long to instruct Bu, promising acceptance of surrender.

units.zh: 旋复叛称王，至五年中乃破。
units.en: He soon rebelled again, proclaimed himself king, and was not crushed until mid–Jianwu 5.
units.literal: Soon he again rebelled and declared himself king; down to the middle of the fifth year he was then broken.

units.zh: 三年五月乙卯晦，日有蚀之，在柳十四度。
units.en: At month's end on yimao in the fifth month of Jianwu 3 (27), the sun was eclipsed at fourteen degrees in Liu.
units.literal: On the last day yimao of the fifth month of the third year, there was a solar eclipse, at fourteen degrees in Liu.

units.zh: 柳，河南也。
units.en: Liu maps to the Henan region south of the Yellow River.
units.literal: Liu is Henan south of the river.

units.zh: 时，世祖在雒阳，赤眉降贼樊崇谋作乱，其七月发觉，皆伏诛。
units.en: The emperor was at Luoyang when Fan Chong of the surrendered Red Eyebrows plotted a coup; the plot surfaced in the seventh month and the conspirators were put to death.
units.literal: At the time the Shizu was in Luoyang; the surrendered Red Eyebrow bandit Fan Chong plotted rebellion; in the seventh month it was discovered, and all were executed.

units.zh: 六年九月丙寅晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on bingyin in the ninth month of Jianwu 6 (30), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the last day bingyin of the ninth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 史官不见，郡以闻。
units.en: Court astronomers missed it; word came in from a commandery.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; a commandery reported it.

units.zh: 在尾八度。
units.en: The sun stood at eight degrees in Wei.
units.literal: It was at eight degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 七年三月癸亥晦，日有蚀之，在毕五度。
units.en: At month's end on guihai in the third month of Jianwu 7 (31), an eclipse fell at five degrees in Bi.
units.literal: On the last day guihai of the third month of the seventh year, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Bi.

units.zh: 毕为边兵。
units.en: Bi presages warfare on the frontier.
units.literal: Bi is border troops.

units.zh: 秋，隗嚣反，侵安定。
units.en: That autumn Wei Xiao rose in revolt and struck into Anding.
units.literal: In autumn Wei Xiao rebelled and invaded Anding.

units.zh: 冬，卢芳所置朔方、云中太守各举郡降。
units.en: In winter the puppet governors of Shuofang and Yunzhong whom Lu Fang had appointed surrendered their commands.
units.literal: In winter the Shuofang and Yunzhong governors installed by Lu Fang each raised their commanderies and surrendered.

units.zh: 十六年三月辛丑晦，日有蚀之，在昴七度。
units.en: At month's end on xinchou in the third month of Jianwu 16 (40), the sun was eclipsed at seven degrees in Mao.
units.literal: On the last day xinchou of the third month of the sixteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at seven degrees in Mao.

units.zh: 昂为狱事。
units.en: Mao governs prisons and penal cases.
units.literal: Mao is prison affairs.

units.zh: 时诸郡太守坐度田不实，世祖怒，杀十余人，然后深悔之。
units.en: Several commandery governors had falsified their land surveys; Guangwu flew into a rage and executed more than a dozen, then bitterly repented.
units.literal: At the time various commandery governors sat guilty of untrue land measurement; the Shizu was angry and killed more than ten persons, afterward deeply regretting it.

units.zh: 十七年二月乙未晦，日有蚀之，在胃九度。
units.en: At month's end on yiwei in the second month of Jianwu 17 (41), an eclipse occurred at nine degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the last day yiwei of the second month of the seventeenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at nine degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 胃为廪仓。
units.en: Wei signifies the state granaries.
units.literal: Wei is the granary.

units.zh: 时诸郡新坐租之后，天下忧怖，以谷为言，故示象。
units.en: Commanderies had just been fined for tax irregularities; the realm was anxious and talk ran to grain shortages—hence Heaven mirrored the distress in the sky.
units.literal: At the time the various commanderies had newly suffered punishment over rent; all under Heaven was anxious and fearful, speaking in terms of grain; therefore it showed an image.

units.zh: 或曰：胃，供养之官也。
units.en: Others read Wei as the palace department that supplies the court.
units.literal: Some say: Wei is the office of provision and support.

units.zh: 其十月，废郭皇后，诏曰「不可以奉供养」。
units.en: That tenth month Empress Guo was cast aside with an edict declaring her unfit to "maintain the ancestral sacrifices."
units.literal: In that tenth month Empress Guo was deposed; an edict said "she cannot undertake provision and support."

units.zh: 二十二年五月乙未晦，日有蚀之，在柳七度，京都宿也。
units.en: At month's end on yiwei in the fifth month of Jianwu 22 (46), the sun was eclipsed at seven degrees in Liu—the lodge of the capital itself.
units.literal: On the last day yiwei of the fifth month of the twenty-second year, there was a solar eclipse, at seven degrees in Liu, the capital's lodging.

units.zh: 柳为上仓，祭祀谷也，近舆鬼，舆鬼为宗庙。
units.en: Liu is the "upper granary" of ritual grain; it neighbors Yugi, the asterism of the ancestral shrine.
units.literal: Liu is the upper granary, grain for sacrifice; it is near Yugi; Yugi is the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 十九年中，有司奏请立近帝四庙以祭之，有诏「庙处所未定，且就高庙袷祭之。」
units.en: In the midst of the nineteenth year, responsible officials memorialized requesting to establish four temples to recent emperors to sacrifice to them; there was an edict: "The site of the temples is not yet fixed; for now perform the xia sacrifice at the High Temple."
units.literal: In the midst of the nineteenth year, responsible officials memorialized requesting to establish four temples to recent emperors to sacrifice to them; there was an edict: "The site of the temples is not yet fixed; for now perform the xia sacrifice at the High Temple."

units.zh: 至此三年，遂不立庙。
units.en: Three years passed, and still no separate shrines were built.
units.literal: From then three years passed, and temples were still not established.

units.zh: 有简堕心，奉祖宗之道有阙，故示象也。
units.en: The court had grown slack toward the ancestors; the rites owed to the imperial dead were neglected—hence the warning in the heavens.
units.literal: There was neglect and slackness of mind; the way of honoring the ancestors had gaps; therefore it showed an image.

units.zh: 二十五年三月戊申晦，日有蚀之，在毕十五度。
units.en: At month's end on wushen in the third month of Jianwu 25 (49), an eclipse fell at fifteen degrees in Bi.
units.literal: On the last day wushen of the third month of the twenty-fifth year, there was a solar eclipse, at fifteen degrees in Bi.

units.zh: 毕为边兵。
units.en: Again Bi pointed to frontier war.
units.literal: Bi is border troops.

units.zh: 其冬十月，以武谿蛮夷为寇害，伏波将军马援将兵击之。
units.en: That winter, in the tenth month, Ma Yuan marched south against the Wuxi tribes who were plundering the border.
units.literal: That winter in the tenth month, because the Wuxi Man and Yi were raiding harm, General Who Crosses the Waves Ma Yuan led troops to strike them.

units.zh: 二十九年二月丁巳朔，日有蚀之，在东壁五度。
units.en: On the new moon dingsi in the second month of Jianwu 29 (53), the sun was eclipsed at five degrees in Eastern Wall.
units.literal: On the dingsi new-moon day of the second month of the twenty-ninth year, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Eastern Wall.

units.zh: 东壁为文章，一名娵訾之口。
units.en: Eastern Wall governs letters and learning; it is also called the mouth of the Ju zi lunar mansion.
units.literal: Eastern Wall is literary composition; one name is the mouth of Ju zi.

units.zh: 先是皇子诸王各招来文章谈说之士，去年中，有人上奏：「诸王所招待者，或真伪杂，受刑罚者子孙，宜可分别。」
units.en: The princes had been patronizing scholars and debaters; the year before, a memorial warned that their clients included descendants of convicted men and demanded a vetting process.
units.literal: Earlier the imperial sons and various kings each summoned men of letters and disputers; in the previous year someone memorialized: "Those whom the kings entertain are sometimes mixed true and false; descendants of those who suffered punishment should be distinguished."

units.zh: 于是上怒，诏捕诸王客，皆被以苛法，死者甚多。
units.en: Enraged, Guangwu ordered a sweep of the princes' retainers; harsh statutes were applied and many died.
units.literal: Thereupon the sovereign was angry, edicting to arrest the kings' guests; all were charged under harsh law, and the dead were very many.

units.zh: 世祖不早为明设刑禁，一时治之过差，故天示象。
units.en: Because he had not laid down clear rules in advance, the purge overshot its mark—so Heaven sent a sign.
units.literal: The Shizu had not early set clear penal prohibitions; in one moment governance overshot; therefore Heaven showed an image.

units.zh: 世祖于是改悔，遣使悉理侵枉也。
units.en: He then relented and dispatched agents to redress every wrongful conviction.
units.literal: The Shizu thereupon repented and sent envoys to fully rectify encroachments and wrongs.

units.zh: 三十一年五月癸酉晦，日有蚀之，在柳五度，京都宿也。
units.en: At month's end on guiyou in the fifth month of Jianwu 31 (55), an eclipse struck Liu at five degrees—the capital's own lodge.
units.literal: On the last day guiyou of the fifth month of the thirty-first year, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Liu, the capital's lodging.

units.zh: 自二十一年示象至此十年，后二年，宫车晏驾。
units.en: Ten years had passed since the omen of Jianwu 21; two years after this eclipse, Guangwu died.
units.literal: From the twenty-first year's showing of image down to here ten years; after two years, the palace carriage delayed its departure (the emperor died).

units.zh: 中元元年十一月甲子晦，日有蚀之，在斗二十度。
units.en: At month's end on jiazi in the eleventh month of Zhongyuan 1 (56), the sun was eclipsed at twenty degrees in Dou.
units.literal: On the last day jiazi of the eleventh month of the first year of Zhongyuan, there was a solar eclipse, at twenty degrees in Dou.

units.zh: 斗为庙，主爵禄。
units.en: Dou is the lodge of the ancestral shrine and of titles and stipends.
units.literal: Dou is the temple; it governs enfeoffment and salary.

units.zh: 儒说十一月甲子，时王日也，又为星纪，主爵禄，其占重。
units.en: Scholars note that jiazi in the eleventh month is the "king" stem-branch day, and the month belongs to the Star Marker cycle—both tie to rank and revenue, so the omen weighed heavily.
units.literal: Confucian explanation: eleventh month jiazi is the king day of the hour; it is also Star Marker; it governs enfeoffment and salary; its prognostication is weighty.

units.zh: 明帝永平三年八月壬申晦，日有蚀之，在氐二度。
units.en: At month's end on renshen in the eighth month of Yongping 3 (60), an eclipse occurred at two degrees in Di.
units.literal: On the last day renshen of the eighth month of the third year of Yongping of Emperor Ming, there was a solar eclipse, at two degrees in Di.

units.zh: 氐为宿宫。
units.en: Di is the lodge of the ruler's sleeping quarters.
units.literal: Di is the lodging palace.

units.zh: 是时明帝作北宫。
units.en: Emperor Ming was then raising the Northern Palace.
units.literal: At this time Emperor Ming was building the Northern Palace.

units.zh: 八年十月壬寅晦，日有蚀之，既，在斗十一度。
units.en: At month's end on renyin in the tenth month of Yongping 8 (65), a total eclipse reached eleven degrees in Dou.
units.literal: On the last day renyin of the eighth month of the eighth year, there was a solar eclipse; it was total, at eleven degrees in Dou.

units.zh: 斗，吴也。
units.en: Dou corresponds to the old state of Wu.
units.literal: Dou is Wu.

units.zh: 广陵于天文属吴。
units.en: By celestial reckoning Guangling lies in the Wu sector.
units.literal: Guangling in astronomical terms belongs to Wu.

units.zh: 后二年，广陵王荆坐谋反自杀。
units.en: Two years later Prince Jing of Guangling killed himself after a conviction for treason.
units.literal: After two years Prince Jing of Guangling sat guilty of plotting rebellion and committed suicide.

units.zh: 十三年十月甲辰晦，日有蚀之，在尾十七度。
units.en: At month's end on jiachen in the tenth month of Yongping 13 (70), the sun was eclipsed at seventeen degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the last day jiachen of the tenth month of the thirteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at seventeen degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 十六年五月戊午晦，日有蚀之，在柳十五度。
units.en: At month's end on wuwu in the fifth month of Yongping 16 (73), an eclipse fell at fifteen degrees in Liu.
units.literal: On the last day wuwu of the fifth month of the sixteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at fifteen degrees in Liu.

units.zh: 儒说五月戊午，犹十一月甲子也，又宿在京都，其占重。
units.en: Scholars liken wuwu in the fifth month to jiazi in the eleventh month, and Liu again marked the capital—so the portent was grave.
units.literal: Confucian explanation: fifth month wuwu is like eleventh month jiazi; moreover the lodging is at the capital region; its prognostication is weighty.

units.zh: 后二岁，宫车晏驾。
units.en: Two years later Emperor Ming died.
units.literal: After two years the palace carriage delayed its departure.

units.zh: 十八年十一月甲辰晦，日有蚀之，在斗二十一度。
units.en: At month's end on jiachen in the eleventh month of Yongping 18 (75), an eclipse occurred at twenty-one degrees in Dou.
units.literal: On the last day jiachen of the eleventh month of the eighteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at twenty-one degrees in Dou.

units.zh: 是时，明帝既崩，马太后制爵禄，故阳不胜。
units.en: Ming had just died, and Empress Dowager Ma held the power of appointments—yang, the masculine principle of rule, was eclipsed.
units.literal: At this time Emperor Ming had already died; Empress Dowager Ma controlled enfeoffment and salary; therefore yang did not overcome.

units.zh: 章帝建初五年二月庚辰朔，日有蚀之，在东壁八度。
units.en: On the new moon gengchen in the second month of Zhangdi's Jianchu 5 (80), the sun was eclipsed at eight degrees in Eastern Wall.
units.literal: On the gengchen new-moon day of the second month of the fifth year of Jianchu of Emperor Zhang, there was a solar eclipse, at eight degrees in Eastern Wall.

units.zh: 例在前建武二十九年。
units.en: The parallel case is recorded under Jianwu 29.
units.literal: The precedent is before, in Jianwu twenty-ninth year.

units.zh: 是时，群臣争经，多相非毁者。
units.en: Courtiers were wrangling over exegetical tradition and tearing one another down in debate.
units.literal: At this time the various ministers disputed the classics, many mutually slandering.

units.zh: 六年六月辛未晦，日有蚀之，在翼六度。
units.en: At month's end on xinwei in the sixth month of Jianchu 6 (81), an eclipse struck six degrees in Yi.
units.literal: On the last day xinwei of the sixth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse, at six degrees in Yi.

units.zh: 翼主远客。
units.en: Yi presages envoys and guests from afar.
units.literal: Yi governs distant guests.

units.zh: 冬，东平王苍等来朝，明年正月，苍薨。
units.en: That winter Prince Cang of Dongping attended court; he died the following first month.
units.literal: In winter Prince Cang of Dongping and others came to court; in the first month of the next year Cang died.

units.zh: 章和元年八月乙未晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on yiwei in the eighth month of Zhanghe 1 (87), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the last day yiwei of the eighth month of the first year of Zhanghe, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 史官不见，佗官以闻。
units.en: Court astronomers missed it; another office relayed the news.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; another official reported it.

units.zh: 日在氐四度。
units.en: The disk stood at four degrees in Di.
units.literal: The sun was at four degrees in Di.

units.zh: 和帝永元二年二月壬午，日有蚀之。
units.en: On renwu in the second month of Yongyuan 2 (90), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On renwu day of the second month of the second year of Yongyuan of Emperor He, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 史官不见，涿郡以闻。
units.en: Astronomers at the capital failed to record it; Zhuo Commandery sent word.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Zhuo Commandery reported it.

units.zh: 日在奎八度。
units.en: The eclipse point lay at eight degrees in Kui.
units.literal: The sun was at eight degrees in Kui.

units.zh: 四年六月戊戌朔，日有蚀之，在七星二度，主衣裳。
units.en: On the new moon wuxu in the sixth month of Yongyuan 4 (92), the sun was eclipsed at two degrees in the Seven Stars—the lodge of court dress.
units.literal: On the wuxu new-moon day of the sixth month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse, at two degrees in the Seven Stars; it governs robes and skirts.

units.zh: 又曰行近轩辕，在左角，为太后族。
units.en: Some add that the path brushed Xuanyuan at the left horn—the sector of the empress dowager's kin.
units.literal: It is also said the course drew near Xuanyuan, at the left horn, being the empress dowager's clan.

units.zh: 是月十九日，上免太后兄弟窦宪等官，遣就国，选严能相，于国蹙迫自杀。
units.en: On the nineteenth of that month the emperor stripped Dou Xian and his brothers of office, packed them off to their fiefs, installed harsh overseers, and drove them to suicide.
units.literal: On the nineteenth day of that month the sovereign dismissed the empress dowager's brothers Dou Xian and others from office, sent them to their states, selected stern capable chancellors, and in the states they were pressed and committed suicide.

units.zh: 七年四月辛亥朔，日有蚀之，在嘴觿，为葆旅，主收敛。
units.en: On the new moon xinhai in the fourth month of Yongyuan 7 (95), an eclipse fell in the Beak asterisms (Zuixi); the lodge signifies mustering hosts and tightening control.
units.literal: On the xinhai new-moon day of the fourth month of the seventh year, there was a solar eclipse, at Zui and Xi; it is Baolü; it governs gathering in.

units.zh: 儒说葆旅宫中之象，收敛贪妒之象。
units.en: Scholars read Baolü as a sign of intrigue within the harem—jealous grasping and the reining in of rivals.
units.literal: Confucian explanation: Baolü is an image inside the palace; gathering in is an image of greed and jealousy.

units.zh: 是岁邓贵人始人。
units.en: That year Lady Deng entered the palace as a concubine.
units.literal: That year Honored Person Deng first entered the palace.

units.zh: 明年三月，阴皇后立，邓贵人有宠，阴后妒忌之，后遂坐废。
units.en: The next third month Empress Yin was enthroned while Lady Deng won the emperor's favor; Yin's jealousy led to her own deposition.
units.literal: In the third month of the next year Empress Yin was established; Honored Person Deng had favor; Empress Yin was jealous of her; afterward she sat deposed.

units.zh: 一曰是将入参，参、伐为斩刈。
units.en: Another line of interpretation: the sun was moving toward Shen; Shen and the Fa asterism mean beheading and slaughter.
units.literal: One account says it was about to enter Shen; Shen and Fa are execution and cutting.

units.zh: 明年七月，越骑校尉冯柱捕斩匈奴温禺犊王乌居战。
units.en: The following seventh month Feng Zhu, colonel of agile cavalry, captured and executed the Xiongnu chieftain Wuju zhan of the Wenyudou royal house.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the next year Colonel of Agile Cavalry Feng Zhu captured and beheaded the Xiongnu King Wenyudou Wuju zhan.

units.zh: 十二年秋七月辛亥朔，日有蚀之，在翼八度，荆州宿也。
units.en: On the new moon xinhai in the seventh month of Yongyuan 12 (100), an eclipse occurred at eight degrees in Yi—the lodge of Jingzhou.
units.literal: On the xinhai new-moon day of the seventh month in autumn of the twelfth year, there was a solar eclipse, at eight degrees in Yi, Jingzhou's lodging.

units.zh: 明年冬，南郡蛮夷反，为寇。
units.en: The next winter the southern tribes of Nan Commandery rose in revolt.
units.literal: The next winter the Man and Yi of Nan Commandery rebelled and became raiders.

units.zh: 十五年四月甲子晦，日有蚀之，在东井二十二度。
units.en: At month's end on jiazi in the fourth month of Yongyuan 15 (103), the sun was eclipsed at twenty-two degrees in Eastern Well.
units.literal: On the last day jiazi of the fourth month of the fifteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at twenty-two degrees in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 东井，主酒食之宿也。
units.en: Eastern Well governs drink and viands—the kitchen of Heaven.
units.literal: Eastern Well is the lodging that governs wine and food.

units.zh: 妇人之职，无非无仪，酒食是议。
units.en: The Odes say a woman's sphere is blameless modesty and the ordering of drink and food.
units.literal: The woman's duty: without fault, without display; wine and food are what she deliberates.

units.zh: 去年冬，邓皇后立，有丈夫之性，与知外事，故天示象。
units.en: The previous winter Empress Deng had been installed; she took a hand in statecraft like a man—Heaven therefore mirrored her overreach in the eclipse.
units.literal: Last winter Empress Deng was established; she had the nature of a man and participated in knowing outer affairs; therefore Heaven showed an image.

units.zh: 是年水，雨伤稼。
units.en: The same year floods and relentless rains ruined the harvest.
units.literal: That year there was flood; rain harmed the crops.

units.zh: 安帝永初元年三月二日癸酉，日有蚀之，在胃二度。
units.en: On guiyou, the second day of the third month of Yongchu 1 (107), the sun was eclipsed at two degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the second day of the third month guiyou of the first year of Yongchu of Emperor An, there was a solar eclipse, at two degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 胃主禀仓。
units.en: Wei again signals the imperial granaries.
units.literal: Wei governs the granary.

units.zh: 是时，邓太后专政，去年大水伤稼，仓禀为虚。
units.en: Empress Dowager Deng held the reins; the previous year's floods had emptied the bins.
units.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Deng monopolized government; last year great water harmed crops; granaries were empty.

units.zh: 五年正月庚辰朔，日有蚀之，在虚八度。
units.en: On the new moon gengchen in the first month of Yongchu 5 (111), an eclipse fell at eight degrees in Xu.
units.literal: On the gengchen new-moon day of the first month of the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse, at eight degrees in Xu.

units.zh: 正月，王者统事之正日也。
units.en: The first month is the month in which the Son of Heaven sets the year in motion.
units.literal: The first month is the correct day when the king presides over affairs.

units.zh: 虚，空名也。
units.en: Xu means "void" and "empty title."
units.literal: Xu is empty name.

units.zh: 是时邓太后摄政，安帝不得行事，俱不得其正，若王者位虚，故于正月阳不克，示象也。
units.en: The dowager ruled in place of the young emperor, so neither occupied the rightful role—like a vacant throne—hence yang failed on the year's first new moon.
units.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Deng held the regency; Emperor An could not carry out affairs; both did not obtain their correctness; as if the king's position were empty; therefore in the first month yang did not overcome—it showed an image.

units.zh: 于是阴预乘阳，故夷狄并为寇害，西边诸郡皆至虚空。
units.en: Yin thus mounted yang; barbarians raided along every frontier, and the western commanderies were laid waste.
units.literal: Thereupon yin beforehand rode yang; therefore the Yi and Di together became raiding harm; the various western commanderies all reached emptiness and void.

units.zh: 七年四月丙申晦，日有蚀之，在东井一度。
units.en: At month's end on bingshen in the fourth month of Yongchu 7 (113), the sun was eclipsed at one degree in Eastern Well.
units.literal: On the last day bingshen of the fourth month of the seventh year, there was a solar eclipse, at one degree in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 元初元年十月戊子朔，日有蚀之，在尾十度。
units.en: On the new moon wuzi in the tenth month of Yuanchu 1 (114), an eclipse occurred at ten degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the wuzi new-moon day of the tenth month of the first year of Yuanchu, there was a solar eclipse, at ten degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 尾为后宫。
units.en: Wei is the asterism of the imperial harem.
units.literal: Wei is the rear palace.

units.zh: 继嗣之宫也。
units.en: It is the lodge that governs heirs and succession.
units.literal: It is the palace of succession.

units.zh: 是时上甚幸阎贵人，将立，故示不善，将为继嗣祸也。
units.en: The emperor doted on Lady Yan and meant to make her empress; the eclipse foretold ill for the heir and the dynasty's line.
units.literal: At this time the sovereign greatly favored Honored Person Yan and was about to establish her; therefore it showed not good—there would be calamity for succession.

units.zh: 明年四月，遂立为后。
units.en: The following fourth month she was enthroned as empress.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the next year, she was then established as empress.

units.zh: 后遂与江京、耿宝等共谗太子，废之。
units.en: She then joined Jiang Jing, Geng Bao, and others in poisoning the heir apparent's name until he was cast aside.
units.literal: Afterward she together with Jiang Jing, Geng Bao and others jointly slandered the heir apparent and deposed him.

units.zh: 二年九月壬午晦，日有蚀之，在心四度。
units.en: At month's end on renwu in the ninth month of Yuanchu 2 (115), the sun was eclipsed at four degrees in the Heart mansion.
units.literal: On the last day renwu of the ninth month of the second year, there was a solar eclipse, at four degrees in Xin.

units.zh: 心为王者，明久失位也。
units.en: The Heart is the ruler's star; the eclipse meant the true king had long forfeited his seat.
units.literal: Xin is for the king; the brightness long lost its position.

units.zh: 三年三月二日辛亥，日有蚀之，在娄五度。
units.en: On xinhai, the second day of the third month of Yuanchu 3 (116), an eclipse fell at five degrees in Lou.
units.literal: On the second day of the third month xinhai of the third year, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Lou.

units.zh: 史官不见，辽东以闻。
units.en: Court astronomers missed it; Liaodong relayed the sighting.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Liaodong reported it.

units.zh: 四年二月乙已朔，日有蚀之，在奎九度。
units.en: On the new moon yisi in the second month of Yuanchu 4 (117), the sun was eclipsed at nine degrees in Kui.
units.literal: On the yisi new-moon day of the second month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse, at nine degrees in Kui.

units.zh: 史官不见，七郡以闻。
units.en: Capital scribes failed to record it; seven commanderies sent separate reports.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; seven commanderies reported it.

units.zh: 奎主武库兵。
units.en: Kui presages the imperial arsenal and its arms.
units.literal: Kui governs armory weapons.

units.zh: 其月十八日壬戌，武库火，烧兵器也。
units.en: On renxu the eighteenth of that month the Luoyang armory burned, consuming stacks of weapons.
units.literal: On the eighteenth day of that month renxu, the armory caught fire—it burned weapons.

units.zh: 五年八月丙申朔，日有蚀之，在翼十八度。
units.en: On the new moon bingshen in the eighth month of Yuanchu 5 (118), an eclipse reached eighteen degrees in Yi.
units.literal: On the bingshen new-moon day of the eighth month of the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse, at eighteen degrees in Yi.

units.zh: 史官不见，张掖以闻。
units.en: Astronomers at court did not see it; Zhangye Commandery reported the eclipse.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Zhangye reported it.

units.zh: 六年十二月戊午朔，日有食之，几尽，地如昏状。
units.en: On the new moon wuwu in the twelfth month of Yuanchu 6 (119), a nearly total eclipse darkened the land like twilight.
units.literal: On the wuwu new-moon day of the twelfth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse; it was almost total; the earth was like dusk.

units.zh: 在须女十一度，女主恶之。
units.en: It struck eleven degrees in the Girl asterism—an ill omen for the ruling empress.
units.literal: It was at eleven degrees in Girl; the chief woman detested it.

units.zh: 后二岁三月，邓太后崩。
units.en: Two years later, in the third month, Empress Dowager Deng passed away.
units.literal: After two years, in the third month, Empress Dowager Deng died.

units.zh: 永宁元年七月乙酉朔，日有蚀之，在张十五度。
units.en: On the new moon yiyou in the seventh month of Yongning 1 (120), the sun was eclipsed at fifteen degrees in Zhang.
units.literal: On the yiyou new-moon day of the seventh month of the first year of Yongning, there was a solar eclipse, at fifteen degrees in Zhang.

units.zh: 史官不见，酒泉以闻。
units.en: The capital observatory missed it; Jiuquan sent word.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Jiuquan reported it.

units.zh: 延光三年九月庚申晦，日有食之，在氐十五度。
units.en: At month's end on gengshen in the ninth month of Yanguang 3 (124), an eclipse occurred at fifteen degrees in Di.
units.literal: On the last day gengshen of the ninth month of the third year of Yanguang, there was a solar eclipse, at fifteen degrees in Di.

units.zh: 氐为宿宫。
units.en: Di is the lodge of the ruler's private apartments.
units.literal: Di is the lodging palace.

units.zh: 宫，中宫也。
units.en: Here "palace" denotes the empress's domain at the center of the court.
units.literal: Palace means the central palace.

units.zh: 时上听中常侍江京、樊丰及阿母王圣等谗言，废皇太子。
units.en: The emperor trusted Jiang Jing, Fan Feng, and his wet nurse Wang Sheng, believed their lies, and deposed the crown prince.
units.literal: At the time the sovereign listened to the slanderous words of Regular Attendants Jiang Jing and Fan Feng and of his nurse Wang Sheng and others, and deposed the crown prince.

units.zh: 四年三月戊午朔，日有蚀之，在胃十二度。
units.en: On the new moon wuwu in the third month of Yanguang 4 (125), the sun was eclipsed at twelve degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the wuwu new-moon day of the third month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse, at twelve degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 陇西、酒泉、朔方各以状上，史官不觉。
units.en: Longxi, Jiuquan, and Shuofang all filed reports, yet the capital historians failed to note the eclipse.
units.literal: Longxi, Jiuquan, and Shuofang each submitted situation reports upward; the clerks of history did not notice.

units.zh: 顺帝永建二年七月甲戌朔，日有蚀之，在翼九度。
units.en: On the new moon jiaxu in the seventh month of Yongjian 2 (127), an eclipse struck nine degrees in Yi.
units.literal: On the jiaxu new-moon day of the seventh month of the second year of Yongjian of Emperor Shun, there was a solar eclipse, at nine degrees in Yi.

units.zh: 阳嘉四年闰月丁亥朔，日有蚀之，在角五度。
units.en: On the new moon dinghai in the intercalary month of Yangjia 4 (135), the sun was eclipsed at five degrees in Horn.
units.literal: On the dinghai new-moon day of the intercalary month of the fourth year of Yangjia, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Horn.

units.zh: 史官不见，零陵以闻。
units.en: Court scribes missed it; Lingling Commandery reported the event.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Lingling reported it.

units.zh: 永和三年十二月戊戌朔，日有蚀之，在须女十一度。
units.en: On the new moon wuxu in the twelfth month of Yonghe 3 (138), an eclipse occurred at eleven degrees in the Girl asterism.
units.literal: On the wuxu new-moon day of the twelfth month of the third year of Yonghe, there was a solar eclipse, at eleven degrees in Girl.

units.zh: 史官不见，会稽以闻。
units.en: The observatory at Luoyang saw nothing; Kuaiji relayed the eclipse.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Kuaiji reported it.

units.zh: 明年，中常侍张逵等谋谮皇后父梁商欲作乱，推考，逵等伏诛也。
units.en: The next year Zhang Kui and other eunuchs tried to frame Liang Shang for treason; the plot collapsed and they were executed.
units.literal: The next year Regular Attendants Zhang Kui and others plotted to slander the empress's father Liang Shang, wishing to charge rebellion; under investigation, Kui and others were executed.

units.zh: 五年五月己丑晦，日有蚀之，在东井三十三度。
units.en: At month's end on jichou in the fifth month of Yonghe 5 (140), the sun was eclipsed at thirty-three degrees in Eastern Well.
units.literal: On the last day jichou of the fifth month of the fifth year, there was a solar eclipse, at thirty-three degrees in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 东井，三辅宿。
units.en: Eastern Well governs the capital region of the Three Supports.
units.literal: Eastern Well is the lodge of the Three Supports.

units.zh: 又近舆鬼，舆鬼为宗庙。
units.en: It borders Yugi, the asterism of the imperial shrines.
units.literal: It is also near Yugi; Yugi is the ancestral temple.

units.zh: 其秋，西羌为寇，至三辅陵园。
units.en: That autumn Qiang raiders from the west broke through to the mausoleum parks around Chang'an.
units.literal: That autumn the Western Qiang became raiders and reached the imperial tombs of the Three Supports.

units.zh: 六年九月辛亥晦，日有蚀之，在尾十一度。
units.en: At month's end on xinhai in the ninth month of Yonghe 6 (141), an eclipse fell at eleven degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the last day xinhai of the ninth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse, at eleven degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 尾主后宫，继嗣之宫也。
units.en: Wei rules the harem and the matter of heirs.
units.literal: Wei governs the rear palace; it is the palace of succession.

units.zh: 以为继嗣不兴之象。
units.en: Readers took it as a sign that the imperial line would not flourish.
units.literal: It was taken as an image of succession not rising.

units.zh: 桓帝建和元年正月辛亥朔，日有蚀之，在营室三度。
units.en: On the new moon xinhai in the first month of Jianhe 1 (147), the sun was eclipsed at three degrees in Encampment.
units.literal: On the xinhai new-moon day of the first month of the first year of Jianhe of Emperor Huan, there was a solar eclipse, at three degrees in Encampment.

units.zh: 史官不见，郡国以闻。
units.en: Capital historians missed it; reports arrived from the provinces.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; commanderies and kingdoms reported it.

units.zh: 是时梁太后摄政。
units.en: Empress Dowager Liang was then regent for the boy emperor.
units.literal: At this time Empress Dowager Liang held the regency.

units.zh: 三年四月丁卯晦，日有蚀之，在东井二十三度。
units.en: At month's end on dingmao in the fourth month of Jianhe 3 (149), an eclipse reached twenty-three degrees in Eastern Well.
units.literal: On the last day dingmao of the fourth month of the third year, there was a solar eclipse, at twenty-three degrees in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 例在永元十五年。
units.en: The parallel case is discussed under Yongyuan 15.
units.literal: The precedent is in Yongyuan fifteenth year.

units.zh: 东井主法，梁太后又听兄冀枉杀公卿，犯天法也。
units.en: Eastern Well stands for justice; the dowager let her brother Liang Ji murder ministers without cause—a breach of Heaven's law.
units.literal: Eastern Well governs law; Empress Dowager Liang again listened as her brother Ji wrongly killed dukes and ministers, offending Heaven's law.

units.zh: 明年，太后崩。
units.en: The following year the empress dowager died.
units.literal: The next year the empress dowager died.

units.zh: 元嘉二年七月二日庚辰，日有蚀之，在翼四度。
units.en: On gengchen, the second day of the seventh month of Yuanjia 2 (152), the sun was eclipsed at four degrees in Yi.
units.literal: On the second day of the seventh month gengchen of the second year of Yuanjia, there was a solar eclipse, at four degrees in Yi.

units.zh: 史官不见，广陵以闻。
units.en: Luoyang's astronomers saw nothing; Guangling reported the eclipse.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; Guangling reported it.

units.zh: 翼主倡乐。
units.en: Yi presides over music, dance, and court entertainments.
units.literal: Yi governs performers and music.

units.zh: 时上好乐过。
units.en: The emperor was then addicted to spectacle and song.
units.literal: At the time the sovereign loved music excessively.

units.zh: 永兴二年九月丁卯朔，日有蚀之，在角五度。
units.en: On the new moon dingmao in the ninth month of Yongxing 2 (154), an eclipse occurred at five degrees in Horn.
units.literal: On the dingmao new-moon day of the ninth month of the second year of Yongxing, there was a solar eclipse, at five degrees in Horn.

units.zh: 角，郑宿也。
units.en: Horn corresponds to the old state of Zheng.
units.literal: Horn is the lodge of Zheng.

units.zh: 十一月，泰山盗贼群起，劫杀长吏。
units.en: In the eleventh month bandit gangs erupted on Mount Tai, robbing and murdering officials.
units.literal: In the eleventh month bandits on Mount Tai rose in groups, plundering and killing senior clerks.

units.zh: 泰山于天文属郑。
units.en: By celestial mapping Mount Tai lies in the Zheng sector.
units.literal: Mount Tai in astronomical terms belongs to Zheng.

units.zh: 永寿三年闰月庚辰晦，日有蚀之，在七星二度。
units.en: At month's end on gengchen in the intercalary month of Yongshou 3 (157), the sun was eclipsed at two degrees in the Seven Stars.
units.literal: On the last day gengchen of the intercalary month of the third year of Yongshou, there was a solar eclipse, at two degrees in the Seven Stars.

units.zh: 史官不见，郡国以闻，例在永元四年。
units.en: Provincial reports replaced a silent capital record; the parallel is under Yongyuan 4.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; commanderies and kingdoms reported it; the precedent is in Yongyuan fourth year.

units.zh: 后二岁，梁皇后崩，冀兄弟被诛。
units.en: Two years later Empress Liang died, and Liang Ji and his brothers were executed.
units.literal: After two years Empress Liang died, and the Yi brothers were executed.

units.zh: 延熹元年五月甲戌晦，日有蚀之，在柳七度，京都宿也。
units.en: At month's end on jiaxu in the fifth month of Yanxi 1 (158), an eclipse struck Liu at seven degrees—the capital's own lodge.
units.literal: On the last day jiaxu of the fifth month of the first year of Yanxi, there was a solar eclipse, at seven degrees in Liu, the capital's lodging.

units.zh: 八年正月丙甲晦，日有蚀之，在营室十三度。
units.en: At month's end on bingjia in the first month of Yanxi 8 (165), the sun was eclipsed at thirteen degrees in Encampment.
units.literal: On the last day bingjia of the first month of the eighth year of Yanxi, there was a solar eclipse, at thirteen degrees in Encampment.

units.zh: 营室之中，女主象也。
units.en: Encampment is the mansion of the empress.
units.literal: Within Encampment is the image of the chief consort.

units.zh: 其二月癸亥，邓皇后坐酗，上送暴室，令自杀，家属被诛。
units.en: On guihai in the second month Empress Deng was convicted of drunkenness, confined to the Sudden Heat ward, forced to kill herself, and her kin were executed.
units.literal: On its second month guihai, Empress Deng sat guilty of intoxication; the sovereign sent her to the Sudden Heat chamber, ordered her to commit suicide, and her family members were executed.

units.zh: 吕太后崩时亦然。
units.en: The same conjunction had appeared when Empress Dowager Lü died.
units.literal: When Empress Dowager Lü died it was likewise.

units.zh: 九年正月辛卯朔，日有蚀之，在营室三度。
units.en: On the new moon xinmao in the first month of Yanxi 9 (166), an eclipse fell at three degrees in Encampment.
units.literal: On the xinmao new-moon day of the first month of the ninth year, there was a solar eclipse, at three degrees in Encampment.

units.zh: 史官不见，郡国以闻。
units.en: Again the capital missed it; the regions reported the eclipse.
units.literal: The clerks of history did not see it; commanderies and kingdoms reported it.

units.zh: 谷永以为三朝尊者恶之。
units.en: Gu Yong warned that the eclipse was ominous for the senior ministers of the three courts.
units.literal: Gu Yong held that the venerable ones of the three courts detested it.

units.zh: 其明年，宫车晏驾。
units.en: The following year Emperor Huan died.
units.literal: The next year the palace carriage delayed its departure.

units.zh: 永康元年五月壬子晦，日有蚀之，在舆鬼一度。
units.en: At month's end on renzi in the fifth month of Yongkang 1 (167), the sun was eclipsed at one degree in Yugi.
units.literal: On the last day renzi of the fifth month of the first year of Yongkang, there was a solar eclipse, at one degree in Yugi.

units.zh: 儒说壬子淳水日，而阳不克，将有水害。
units.en: Scholars call renzi a "Chunshui" day on which yang falters—foretelling catastrophic floods.
units.literal: Confucian explanation: renzi is a Chunshui day, and yang did not overcome; there will be water harm.

units.zh: 其八月，六州大水，勃海海溢。
units.en: That eighth month six provinces were inundated and the Bohai tide surged over the coast.
units.literal: That eighth month six provinces had great flood; the Bohai sea overflowed.

units.zh: 灵帝建宁元年五月丁未朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon dingwei in the fifth month of Jianning 1 (168), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the dingwei new-moon day of the fifth month of the first year of Jianning of Emperor Ling, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 冬十月甲辰晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on jiachen in the tenth month of that year, another eclipse darkened the sun.
units.literal: On the last day jiachen of the tenth month in winter, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二年十月戊戌晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on wuxu in the tenth month of Jianning 2 (169), the sun was eclipsed again.
units.literal: On the last day wuxu of the tenth month of the second year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 右扶风以闻。
units.en: Youfufeng Commandery relayed the sighting.
units.literal: Right Fufeng reported it.

units.zh: 三年三月丙寅晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on bingyin in the third month of Jianning 3 (170), an eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the last day bingyin of the third month of the third year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 梁相以闻。
units.en: The chancellor of Liang state reported it.
units.literal: The chancellor of Liang reported it.

units.zh: 四年三月辛酉朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon xinyou in the third month of Jianning 4 (171), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the xinyou new-moon day of the third month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 熹平二年十二月癸酉晦，日有蚀之，在虚二度。
units.en: At month's end on guiyou in the twelfth month of Xiping 2 (173), an eclipse struck two degrees in Xu.
units.literal: On the last day guiyou of the twelfth month of the second year of Xiping, there was a solar eclipse, at two degrees in Xu.

units.zh: 是时中常侍曹节、王甫等专权。
units.en: Eunuchs Cao Jie and Wang Fu then dominated the government.
units.literal: At this time Regular Attendants Cao Jie, Wang Fu and others monopolized power.

units.zh: 六年十月癸丑朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon guichou in the tenth month of Xiping 6 (177), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the guichou new-moon day of the tenth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 赵相以闻。
units.en: The chancellor of Zhao Commandery reported it.
units.literal: The chancellor of Zhao reported it.

units.zh: 光和元年二月辛亥朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon xinhai in the second month of Guanghe 1 (178), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the xinhai new-moon day of the second month of the first year of Guanghe, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十月丙子晦，日有蚀之，在箕四度。
units.en: At month's end on bingzi in the tenth month of Guanghe 1, the sun was eclipsed at four degrees in Ji.
units.literal: On the last day bingzi of the tenth month, there was a solar eclipse, at four degrees in Ji.

units.zh: 箕为后宫口舌。
units.en: Ji governs the inner palace and scandalous speech.
units.literal: Ji is the back palace mouths and tongues.

units.zh: 是月，上听谗废宋皇后。
units.en: That month the emperor heeded slander and deposed Empress Song.
units.literal: That month the sovereign listened to slander and deposed Empress Song.

units.zh: 二年四月甲戌朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon jiaxu in the fourth month of Guanghe 2 (179), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the jiaxu new-moon day of the fourth month of the second year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 四年九月庚寅朔，日有蚀之，在角六度。
units.en: On the new moon gengyin in the ninth month of Guanghe 4 (181), the sun was eclipsed at six degrees in Jiao.
units.literal: On the gengyin new-moon day of the ninth month of the fourth year, there was a solar eclipse, at six degrees in Jiao.

units.zh: 中平三年五月壬辰晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on renchen in the fifth month of Zhongping 3 (186), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the last day renchen of the fifth month of the third year of Zhongping, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 六年四月丙午朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon bingwu in the fourth month of Zhongping 6 (189), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the bingwu new-moon day of the fourth month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 其月浃辰，宫车晏驾。
units.en: Twelve days into that same month Emperor Ling died.
units.literal: That month, after a twelve-day span, the palace carriage delayed its departure.

units.zh: 献帝初平四年正月甲寅朔，日有蚀之，在营室四度。
units.en: On the new moon jiayin in the first month of Chuping 4 (193), the sun was eclipsed at four degrees in Encampment.
units.literal: On the jiayin new-moon day of the first month of the fourth year of Chuping of Emperor Xian, there was a solar eclipse, at four degrees in Encampment.

units.zh: 是时，李傕、郭汜专政。
units.en: Li Jue and Guo Si were then dictating policy at Chang'an.
units.literal: At this time Li Jue and Guo Si monopolized government.

units.zh: 兴平元年六月乙巳晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on yisi in the sixth month of Xingping 1 (194), an eclipse darkened the sun.
units.literal: On the last day yisi of the sixth month of the first year of Xingping, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 建安五年九月庚午朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon gengwu in the ninth month of Jian'an 5 (200), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the gengwu new-moon day of the ninth month of the fifth year of Jian'an, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 六年二月丁卯朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon dingmao in the second month of Jian'an 6 (201), another eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the dingmao new-moon day of the second month of the sixth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十三年十月癸未朔，日有蚀之，在尾十二度。
units.en: On the new moon guiwei in the tenth month of Jian'an 13 (208), the sun was eclipsed at twelve degrees in Wei.
units.literal: On the guiwei new-moon day of the tenth month of the thirteenth year, there was a solar eclipse, at twelve degrees in Wei.

units.zh: 十五年二月乙巳朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon yisi in the second month of Jian'an 15 (210), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the yisi new-moon day of the second month of the fifteenth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 十七年六月庚寅晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on gengyin in the sixth month of Jian'an 17 (212), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the last day gengyin of the sixth month of the seventeenth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二十一年五月己亥朔，日有蚀之。
units.en: On the new moon jihai in the fifth month of Jian'an 21 (216), a solar eclipse occurred.
units.literal: On the jihai new-moon day of the fifth month of the twenty-first year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 二十四年二月壬子晦，日有蚀之。
units.en: At month's end on renzi in the second month of Jian'an 24 (219), the sun was eclipsed.
units.literal: On the last day renzi of the second month of the twenty-fourth year, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 凡汉中兴十二世，百九十六年，日蚀七十二：朔三十二，晦三十七，月二日三。
units.en: Across the restored Han line—twelve reigns and one hundred ninety-six years—seventy-two solar eclipses were recorded: thirty-two on new moons, thirty-seven at month's end, and three on the second day.
units.literal: In all, from Han's restoration through twelve reigns, one hundred ninety-six years, solar eclipses were seventy-two: new moon thirty-two, last day thirty-seven, second day of month three.

units.zh: 光武建武七年四月丙寅，日有晕抱，白虹贯晕，在毕八度。
units.en: On bingyin in the fourth month of Jianwu 7 (31), the sun wore a double halo pierced by a white rainbow at eight degrees in Bi.
units.literal: On the bingyin day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Jianwu of Guangwu, the sun had a halo with embrace; a white rainbow pierced the halo; it was at eight degrees in Bi.

units.zh: 毕为边兵。
units.en: Bi again betokened frontier arms.
units.literal: Bi is border troops.

units.zh: 秋，隗嚣反，侵安定。
units.en: That autumn Wei Xiao rose and struck into Anding.
units.literal: In autumn Wei Xiao rebelled and invaded Anding.

units.zh: 灵帝时，日数出东方，正赤如血，无光，高二丈余乃有景。
units.en: Under Emperor Ling the sun often rose in the east the color of clotted blood, dim and nearly lightless until it climbed more than two zhang above the horizon.
units.literal: In the time of Emperor Ling, the sun repeatedly came out in the east, proper red like blood, without light; only when more than two zhang high did it have brightness.

units.zh: 且入西方，去地二丈，亦如之。
units.en: When it set in the west, some two zhang above the horizon, it showed the same blood-red dimness.
units.literal: Moreover when it entered the west, two zhang from the ground, it was likewise.

units.zh: 其占曰，事天不谨，则日月赤。
units.en: The omen texts read: careless service to Heaven turns sun and moon the color of blood.
units.literal: Its prognostication says: serving Heaven without care, then sun and moon are red.

units.zh: 是时，月出入去地二三丈，皆赤如血者数矣。
units.en: The moon, too, when it hung two or three zhang above the horizon at rising or setting, often glowed the same lurid red.
units.literal: At this time, when the moon rose and set two or three zhang from the ground, all were red like blood—several times.

units.zh: 光和四年二月己巳，黄气抱日，黄白珥在其表。
units.en: On jisi in the second month of Guanghe 4 (181), yellowish vapor ringed the sun, with pale yellow prominences flaring from its disk.
units.literal: On the jisi day of the second month of the fourth year of Guanghe, yellow vapor embraced the sun; yellow-white ear-rings were on its outer side.

units.zh: 中平四年三月丙申，黑气大如瓜，在日中。
units.en: On bingshen in the third month of Zhongping 4 (187), a melon-sized black spot appeared on the face of the sun.
units.literal: On the bingshen day of the third month of the fourth year of Zhongping, black vapor as large as a melon was within the sun.

units.zh: 五年正月，日色赤黄，中有黑气如飞鹊，数月乃销。
units.en: In the first month of Zhongping 5 (188) the solar disk turned dull red-yellow with a black streak like a darting magpie; the blemish lingered for months before fading.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, the sun's color was red-yellow; within it was black vapor like a flying magpie; several months then it dissipated.

units.zh: 六年二月乙未，白虹贯日。
units.en: On yiwei in the second month of Zhongping 6 (189), a white rainbow spanned the sun.
units.literal: On the yiwei day of the second month of the sixth year, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 献帝初平元年二月壬辰，白虹贯日。
units.en: On renchen in the second month of Chuping 1 (190), another white rainbow crossed the solar disk.
units.literal: On the renchen day of the second month of the first year of Chuping of Emperor Xian, a white rainbow pierced the sun.

units.zh: 桓帝永寿三年十二月壬戌，月蚀非其月。
units.en: On renxu in the twelfth month of Yongshou 3 (157), a lunar eclipse occurred out of season.
units.literal: On the renxu day of the twelfth month of the third year of Yongshou of Emperor Huan, a lunar eclipse not in its proper month.

units.zh: 延熹八年正月辛巳，月蚀非其月。
units.en: On xinsi in the first month of Yanxi 8 (165), the moon was eclipsed at an improper time.
units.literal: On the xinsi day of the first month of the eighth year of Yanxi, a lunar eclipse not in its proper month.

units.zh: 赞曰：皇极惟建，五事克端。
units.en: The summation reads: when the sovereign holds the center, the five royal duties align true.
units.literal: The eulogy says: the sovereign norm is only established; the five affairs are able to be correct.

units.zh: 罚咎入沴，逆乱浸干。
units.en: Punishments and faults curdle into cosmic disruption; rebellion seeps upward until it stains the throne.
units.literal: Punishment and blame enter calamity; rebellion and disorder soak and encroach.

units.zh: 火下水腾，木弱金酸。
units.en: Fire sinks beneath mounting water; wood withers and metal turns brittle—each element out of true.
units.literal: Fire below, water rises; wood weak, metal sour.

units.zh: 妖岂或妄，气炎以观。
units.en: These portents are no idle tales: read them in the fevered breath of the age.
units.literal: Prodigies—how could they be perhaps false? By vapor flame observe.

units.zh: 時隗囂據壟擁眾，招輯英俊，而公孫述稱帝於蜀漢，天下雲擾，大者連州郡，小者據縣邑。
units.en: Wei Xiao then blocked the Long road and recruited talent while Gongsun Shu styled himself emperor in Shu; the realm splintered into rival zones large and small.
units.literal: At that time Wei Xiao held Long and gathered heroes, while Gongsun Shu declared himself emperor in Shu-Han; all under Heaven boiled like a cloud; the great linked commanderies and the small seized counties.

units.zh: 囂問彪曰：「往者周亡，戰國並爭，天下分裂，數世然後乃定，其抑者從橫之事復起於今乎？
units.en: Wei Xiao asked Ban Biao, "In former times when Zhou fell, the Warring States strove together and the realm split apart, and only after several generations was it settled—will the affairs of vertical and horizontal alliances rise again now,
units.literal: Xiao asked Biao, "In former times when Zhou fell, the Warring States strove together, the realm split apart, and only after several generations was it settled—will the affairs of vertical and horizontal alliances rise again now?

units.zh: 囂曰：「先生言周、漢之勢，可也，至於但見愚民習識劉氏姓號之故，而謂漢家復興，疏矣！
units.en: Wei Xiao said, "What you say, sir, about the tendencies of Zhou and Han is acceptable, but to infer from the mere fact that foolish commoners are habituated to the Liu surname that the house of Han will rise again is far too loose!
units.literal: Xiao said, "What you say, sir, about the tendencies of Zhou and Han is acceptable, but to infer from the mere fact that foolish commoners are habituated to the Liu surname that the house of Han will rise again is far too loose!

units.zh: 既感囂言，又愍狂狡之不息，乃著王命論以救時難。
units.en: Half persuaded by Wei Xiao yet sick of endless adventurism, Ban Biao drafted the Discourse on the King's Mandate to steady a chaotic age.
units.literal: Having been moved by Xiao's words and also pitying that wild cunning would not cease, he thereupon composed the Discourse on the King's Mandate to rescue the troubles of the age.

units.zh: 將承運迭興在於一人也？
units.en: or will the received mandate pass in turn and concentrate in a single man?
units.literal: Or will the received mandate pass in turn and concentrate in a single man?

units.zh: 願先生論之。」
units.en: He begged Ban Biao to give his reading."
units.literal: I beg the master to discuss it."

units.zh: 昔秦失其鹿，劉季逐而掎之，時民復知漢虖！」
units.en: In olden times Qin lost the deer, and Liu Ji chased and seized it—did the people then even know there would be a Han?"
units.literal: In olden times Qin lost the deer, and Liu Ji chased and seized it—did the people then even know there would be a Han?"

units.zh: 以窦后配食章帝，恭怀后别就陵寝祭之。
units.en: Empress Dou shared Zhangdi’s cult, but Empress Gonghuai was worshipped separately at her tomb lodge.
units.literal: Empress Dou was paired to share Zhangdi’s offering, while Empress Gonghuai was separately worshipped at her mausoleum lodge.

units.zh: 本初元年，梁太後詔備古禮以聘厚，遂辭疾不就。
units.en: In Benchu 1 Empress Dowager Liang summoned him with full classical ceremony; he pleaded illness and stayed away.
units.literal: In the first year of Benchu, Empress Dowager Liang issued an edict to engage Hou with ancient ritual; he declined illness and did not go.

units.zh: 建和三年，太後復詔征之，經四年不至。
units.en: In Jianhe 3 she summoned him again, yet four years passed without his appearance.
units.literal: In the third year of Jianhe the empress dowager again ordered him summoned; through four years he did not arrive.

units.zh: 是时，安帝信中常侍樊丰、江京、阿母王圣及外属耿宝等谗言，免太尉杨震，废太子为济阴王，不悊之异也。
units.en: Emperor An was listening to Fan Feng, Jiang Jing, Wang Sheng, and Geng Bao: he cashiered Yang Zhen and cast down the crown prince—exactly the blindness those birds foretold.
units.literal: At that time Emperor An trusted palace attendants Fan Feng, Jiang Jing, nurse Wang Sheng, and outer kin Geng Bao and others’ slanderous words, dismissed Grand Commandant Yang Zhen, and deposed the heir apparent as Prince of Jiyin—a prodigy of lack of discernment.

units.zh: 安帝延光三年二月戊子，有五色大鸟集济南台，十月，又集新丰，时以为凤皇。
units.en: On wuzi in the second month of Yanguang 3 a huge polychrome bird perched on Jinan’s terrace and again at Xinfeng—courtiers hailed it as a phoenix.
units.literal: In Emperor An’s third year of Yanguang, second month, day wuzi, a great five-colored bird alighted on the terrace in Jinan; in the tenth month it again alighted at Xinfeng; the time took it for a phoenix.

units.zh: 或曰，是年六月马太后崩，土功非时兴故也。
units.en: Another gloss ties the plague to Ma's death that sixth month and the untimely earthworks her tomb demanded.
units.literal: Another view says that in that year in the sixth month Empress Dowager Ma died, and earthworks were raised out of season for that reason.

units.zh: 章帝建初四年冬，京都牛大疫。
units.en: Jianchu 4 (79 CE), winter: cattle plague struck the capital herds.
units.literal: In the winter of the fourth year of Jianchu, Emperor Zhang, the capital's cattle suffered a great plague.

units.zh: 董卓部曲將李傕、郭汜、樊稠、張濟等反，攻京師。
units.en: Li Jue, Guo Si, Fan Chou, Zhang Ji, and other officers of Dong Zhuo’s old army turned on the capital.
units.literal: Dong Zhuo’s division commanders Li Jue, Guo Si, Fan Chou, Zhang Ji, and others rebelled and attacked the capital.

units.zh: 三年春正月丁丑，大赦天下。
units.en: On dingchou in the first month of the third year a general amnesty was granted.
units.literal: In the third year, spring, first month dingchou, he issued a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 秋七月，司空种拂免，光祿大夫濟南淳于嘉為司空。
units.en: In the seventh month Chong Fu left the ministry of works; Chunyu Jia of Jinan, grandee of brilliant candidacy, replaced him.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Minister of Works Chong Fu was dismissed, and Grandee of Brilliant Candidacy Chunyu Jia of Jinan was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 九月，李傕自為車騎將軍，郭汜後將軍，樊稠右將軍，張濟鎮東將軍。
units.en: In the ninth month Li Jue took the rank of general of chariots and cavalry, Guo Si became general of the rear, Fan Chou general of the right, and Zhang Ji general who guards the east.
units.literal: In the ninth month, Li Jue personally became General of Chariots and Cavalry, Guo Si General of the Rear, Fan Chou General of the Right, and Zhang Ji General Who Guards the East.

units.zh: 事觉，桓帝收冀及妻寿襄城君印绶，皆自杀。
units.en: When the plot surfaced, Emperor Huan confiscated the credentials of Liang Ji and his wife Lady Shou of Xiangcheng, and the couple committed suicide.
units.literal: When the affair was exposed, Emperor Huan seized the seals and ribbons of Ji and his wife Shou, lady of Xiangcheng; all killed themselves.

units.zh: 永康元年十二月丁丑，桓帝崩，太傅陈蕃、大将军窦武、尚书令尹勋、黄门令山冰等皆枉死，太白犯心，荧惑留守太微之应也。
units.en: On dingchou in the twelfth month of Yongkang 1 Emperor Huan died; Chen Fan, Dou Wu, Yin Xun, Shan Bing, and others perished in the purge—the earthly price of Venus on Heart and Mars rooted in the Grand Tenuity.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, twelfth month, day dingchou, Emperor Huan passed away; Grand Tutor Chen Fan, great general Dou Wu, Director of the Secretariat Yin Xun, Yellow Gate director Shan Bing and others all died unjustly—the correspondence of Great White offending Heart and Mars lingering guarding the Grand Tenuity.

units.zh: 桓帝延熹七年三月癸亥，陨石右扶风一，鄠又陨石二，皆有声如雷。
units.en: On guihai in the third month of Yanxi 7 of Emperor Huan a meteorite struck Youfufeng, and two more fell at Hu, each thundering like a peal from Heaven.
units.literal: In the seventh year of Yanxi of Emperor Huan, in the third month, on the day guihai, a meteorite fell in Youfufeng on the right, one; at Hu again two meteorites, all had sound like thunder.

units.zh: 孝桓建和元年八月壬寅，荧惑犯舆鬼质星。
units.en: On renyin in the eighth month of Jianhe 1, Mars crossed the attendant star of the Ghosts.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianhe of Emperor Huan the Filial and Mighty, in the eighth month, on the day renyin, Mars offended the “substance” star of the Ghosts.

units.zh: 桓三十八 灵二十 献九 陨石
units.en: Thirty-eight portents under Emperor Huan, twenty under Ling, nine under Emperor Xian, and meteorite records.
units.literal: Huan thirty-eight, Ling twenty, Xian nine, meteorite.

units.zh: 桓三十八
units.en: Emperor Huan the Filial and Mighty: thirty-eight entries.
units.literal: Huan: thirty-eight.

units.zh: 後二年，中常侍張逵等復坐誣罔大將軍梁商專恣，悉伏誅。
units.en: Two years later the regular palace attendants Zhang Kui and others were convicted of falsely accusing Grand General Liang Shang of monopolizing power, and all were put to death.
units.literal: Two years later, Regular Palace Attendants Zhang Kui and others were again convicted of slandering Grand General Liang Shang for arrogating power; all were executed.

units.zh: 后四岁，梁皇后崩，梁冀被诛，猛立为皇后，恩宠甚盛。
units.en: Four years later Empress Liang died, Liang Ji fell under the sword, Deng Meng was raised to empress, and imperial favor flooded her house.
units.literal: After four years Empress Liang passed away, Liang Ji was executed, Meng was established as empress, and favor was exceedingly great.

units.zh: 后二年七月，懿献皇后以忧死。
units.en: Two years later, in the seventh month, Honored Empress Xian wasted away and died.
units.literal: After two years, in the seventh month, Honored Empress Xian died of grief.

units.zh: 时，上幸后宫采女邓猛，明年，封猛兄演为南顿侯。
units.en: The emperor then favored the selected attendant Deng Meng; the following year he made her brother Yan marquis of Nandun.
units.literal: At that time the sovereign favored palace woman Deng Meng of the rear palaces; the next year he enfeoffed Meng’s elder brother Yan as marquis of Nandun.

units.zh: 異既走險，迪又逃刑，誑侮王人，為之川藪，遂使袁熙請席，遠歎頭行，馬援觀蛙，猶安井底。
units.en: Yi had fled to the hills and Di had escaped justice. They mocked the king's officers and made a mountain lair—like Yuan Xi asking for a mat and sighing at Touxing far away, like Ma Yuan watching frogs content in a well.
units.literal: Yi had already fled to peril and Di had escaped punishment; they deceived and insulted the king's men and made themselves a mountain lair—so Yuan Xi asked for a mat and sighed far off at Touxing's march, and Ma Yuan watched frogs yet was content in the well bottom.

units.zh: 故司空歐陽公，昔有表奏，請宣薄伐，遙途意合，若伏波之論兵，長逝遺誠，同子顏之勿赦。
units.en: The late minister of works Lord Ouyang once memorialized for a limited campaign; his intent matched ours across the distance, like Fubo's talk of war. Dead, he left a charge like Ziyan's "do not spare."
units.literal: The late minister of works Lord Ouyang in old days had a memorial asking to proclaim a limited campaign; across the distance his intent matched, like Fubo on warfare; long gone he left a testament, the same as Ziyan's "do not spare."

units.zh: 建武元年，赤眉賊率樊崇、逢安等共立劉盆子爲天子。
units.en: In Jianwu's first year the Red Eyebrows, under Fan Chong and Feng An, enthroned the boy Liu Penzi as emperor.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianwu, the Red Eyebrow bandits, led by Fan Chong, Feng An, and others, together set up Liu Penzi as Son of Heaven.

units.zh: 其後遂破壞，崇、安等皆誅死。
units.en: The regime soon fell apart, and Fan Chong, Feng An, and their fellows were put to death.
units.literal: Afterward it was destroyed and broken up; Chong, An, and the others were all executed.

units.zh: 然崇等視之如小兒，百事自由，初不恤錄也。
units.en: Yet Chong and the others treated him like a small child; in a hundred affairs he had a free hand, and at first they did not bother to restrain or keep a record of him.
units.literal: Yet Chong and the others treated him like a small child; in a hundred affairs he had freedom, and at first they did not care to restrain or supervise him.

units.zh: 順帝既立，石與喜皆以阿黨閻顯、江京等策免，復為衛尉。
units.en: When Emperor Shun took the throne, Feng Shi and Liu Xi were cashiered for colluding with Yan Xian and Jiang Jing; Feng Shi later returned as minister of the guards.
units.literal: When Emperor Shun was already established, Shi and Xi both because of currying faction with Yan Xian, Jiang Jing and others were removed by edict; again became minister of the guards.

units.zh: 是时，皇后邓氏僭侈，骄恣专幸。
units.en: Empress Deng had grown haughty, extravagant, and jealous of every rival for the emperor's eye.
units.literal: At that time Empress Deng acted beyond her rank, was arrogant and unrestrained, and monopolized favor.

units.zh: 明年废，以忧死，其家皆诛。
units.en: The following year she was cast down, broken-hearted, and her kin extirpated.
units.literal: The next year she was deposed, died of grief, and her family were all executed.

units.zh: 是时，阎皇后初立，后阎后与外亲耿宝等共谮太子，废为济阴王，更外迎济北王子犊立之，草妖也。
units.en: Empress Yan had just risen; she and Geng Bao framed the crown prince, demoted him, and imported the Jibei boy Liu Du—exactly the "grass prodigy" reading.
units.literal: At that time Empress Yan had just been established; afterward Empress Yan with outer kin Geng Bao and others together slandered the heir apparent, deposed him as Prince of Jiyin, and outwardly brought in the Prince of Jibei’s son Du to establish him—a grass prodigy.

units.zh: 明年，上以谗言废皇太子为济阴王。
units.en: The next year the emperor believed calumny and demoted the crown prince to prince of Jiyin.
units.literal: The next year, on slanderous words, the sovereign deposed the heir apparent as Prince of Jiyin.

units.zh: 躬弟子綱女為和帝皇后，封綱吳房侯，位特進，三子秩、輔、敞，皆黃門侍郎。
units.en: Yin Gang's daughter became Emperor He's empress; Gang was named marquis of Wufang at specially advanced rank; his sons Zhi, Fu, and Chang became palace attendants.
units.literal: Gong's younger brother's son Gang's daughter was Emperor He's empress; Gang was enfeoffed as marquis of Wufang, rank specially advanced; three sons Zhi, Fu, Chang, all were palace attendants of the yellow gate.

units.zh: 後坐巫蠱事廢，綱自殺，輔下獄死，軼、敞徙日南。
units.en: Later the witchcraft scandal broke: Yin Gang committed suicide, Yin Fu died in prison, and his sons Zhi and Chang were exiled to Rinan.
units.literal: Later he sat for the witchcraft affair and was abolished; Gang killed himself; Fu was cast in prison and died; Zhi and Chang were exiled to Rinan. (The first exile's name parallels the brother Zhi named above in the text.)

units.zh: 建武五年冬，盧芳略得北邊諸郡，帝使偏將軍隨弟屯代郡。
units.en: In winter of Jianwu 5, Lu Fang overran the northern commanderies, and the emperor dispatched Adjutant-General Sui Di to station troops in Dai.
units.literal: In the fifth year of Jianwu, winter, Lu Fang seized control of the northern-border commanderies; the emperor sent Adjutant-General Sui Di to encamp in Dai commandery.
